statement.zh: Estrada-Belli 书名「The First Maya Civilization」为作者框架用语，不等于全球或全中美洲「第一」定论。
statement.en: Estrada-Belli’s title framing “The First Maya Civilization” is author framing, not a global or pan-Mesoamerican primacy verdict.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
